items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) = 19.11.2026, which is the triggering event, not counted itself (§187(1) BGB) → day 1 of the 30-day period = 20.11.2026. Counting 30 days: day 30 = 19.12.2026. 19.12.2026 is a Saturday (24.11.2026 is a Tuesday → Dec 1 = Tuesday → Dec 15 = Tuesday → Dec 19 = Saturday). Under §193 BGB, when the last day of a period for performing an obligation falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, it shifts to the next business day. Monday 21.12.2026 is not a public holiday in NRW, so the due date moves to 21.12.2026.
